profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack Web Developer specialized in Javascript, ReactJS, Node.js, SQL, and Database Design
profile.geoLocationName: West New York, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
With over 7 years of experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer, I design and build systems that scale, perform, and stay reliable under pressure. My work spans System Design, Database Design, Frontend development, and Backend development, with deep expertise in JavaScript, React, and Node.js. I have led the development of 100+ web applications and delivered features that reduced complexity, improved speed, and directly supported business growth.


I have architected real-time tracking platforms that cut data handling time by 40%, developed CMS-integrated sites that reduced content update cycles by 60%, and built reusable UI components that accelerated development speed by 30%. On the back end, I’ve optimized databases to boost system performance, deployed Dockerized applications on AWS with 100% uptime, and engineered modular systems that scale effortlessly.

Proficient in React, Node.js, TypeScript, SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and modern cloud technologies, I thrive at the intersection of clean architecture and performance optimization. I’m passionate about creating software that not only works seamlessly today but is designed to adapt and scale for tomorrow.

🚀 Always eager to tackle complex challenges, drive innovation, and contribute to teams that value quality, collaboration, and impact.

 I'm exploring new challenges where I can help build fast, reliable systems and work on meaningful, real-life problems. With a strong background in full-stack development, I'm excited to contribute to teams that value clean architecture, performance, and problem-solving.

If you're hiring for a full-stack role—or know someone who is—let’s connect!


Specialties: ReactJS | Node.js | TypeScript | SQL | PostgreSQL | MongoDB | System Architecture | API Design | AWS | Frontend Development | Backend Development | Database Optimization

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed CMS-integrated sites that reduced content update time by 60% and eliminated reliance on engineering support.
• Improved UI performance by 30% through reusable ReactJS and Tailwind components, enhancing speed and scalability.
• Mentored engineers and enforced code standards, driving delivery consistency and improving team code quality.
• Delivered clean, testable code across 50+ full-stack apps by applying modern stacks and engineering best practices.
• Optimized database queries and architecture for a real estate platform, boosting system speed and reliability.
• Built a full-stack vaccine tracker with Node, React, and PostgreSQL, ensuring 100% data accuracy and security.

• Built a cross-platform mobile app with React Native to track 20+ live processes, improving real-time visibility and responsiveness.
• Conducted on-site analysis of 20+ workflows and 30+ product variations across multiple Missouri facilities, enabling accurate and scalable system design.
